title: Path Following Control System
text: Simulate path-following control using adaptive model predictive controller, 17 inputs, 2 outputs, {Control horizon} sets Controller control horizon; {Use vehicle parameters} defines ego vehicle model using vehicle, {Use vehicle model} defines ego vehicle model using state-space, {Total mass} sets the ego vehicle mass, {Yaw moment of inertia} sets the moment of inertia about the ego vehicle vertical, {Longitudinal distance from center of gravity to front tires} sets the distance from the ego vehicle center of mass to its front, {Longitudinal distance from center of gravity to rear tires} sets the distance from the ego vehicle center of mass to its rear, {Cornering stiffness of front tires} sets the front tire stiffness, {Cornering stiffness of rear tires} sets the rear tire stiffness, {Longitudinal acceleration tracking time constant} sets the time constant for acceleration tracking, {A} sets the initial state matrix of ego vehicle predictive model square, {B} sets the initial input-to-state matrix of ego vehicle predictive model matrix with two, {C} sets the initial state-to-output matrix of ego vehicle predictive model matrix with three, {Initial longitudinal velocity} sets the initial velocity of the ego vehicle model, {Transport lag between model inputs and outputs} sets the total transport lag in ego vehicle model, {Maintain safe distance between lead vehicle and ego vehicle} enables spacing control, {Default spacing} sets the minimum spacing to lead vehicle, {Minimum steering angle} sets the minimum front steering angle, {Maximum steering angle} sets the maximum front steering angle, {Minimum longitudinal acceleration} sets the minimum ego vehicle acceleration, {Maximum longitudinal acceleration} sets the maximum ego vehicle acceleration, {Sample time} sets the controller sample time, {Prediction horizon} sets the controller prediction horizon, {Weight on velocity tracking} sets the tuning weight for longitudinal velocity, {Weight on lateral error} sets the tuning weight for lateral error, {Weight on change of longitudinal acceleration} sets the tuning weight for change in longitudinal, {Weight on change of steering angle} sets the tuning weight for change in steering angle, {Use suboptimal solution} applies suboptimal solution after specified number, {Maximum iteration number} sets the maximum optimization iterations, {Use external signal to enable or disable optimization} adds port for enabling optimization, {Use external signal for bumpless transfer between PFC and other controllers} adds external control signal input port and {Create PFC subsystem} sets the create custom controller. Values come from the instance.
